create.name: Mindfulness.com
create.bio:
Mindfulness.com is a mindfulness app and learning site started by mindfulness teacher Melli O'Brien and technology entrepreneur Matt Dickinson, who first worked together in 2015 on an online gathering of teachers called The Mindfulness Summit. The app itself opened in 2020. The company behind it, Mindfulness United, is Australian, and it still runs the yearly Summit alongside the app and a library of free articles.

Inside the app are well over a thousand guided practices, talks and courses, along with breathing exercises, short gratitude practices, music, nature soundscapes and an always-on stream called Mindful Radio. The teaching is mostly secular mindfulness, drawn from both the insight meditation world and the research community: contributors include Tara Brach, Jack Kornfield, Sharon Salzberg, Joseph Goldstein, Jon Kabat-Zinn, Kristin Neff and Rick Hanson, with O'Brien and Cory Muscara as the main hosts. O'Brien also leads a thirty-day course on the basics of practice. There are two yearly plans, each with a seven-day trial; the fuller one adds a short coached practice chosen for each day of the year and the complete course library.

videos.title: How to Start and Sustain a Daily Mindfulness and Meditation Practice

courses.title: Mindfulness.com Basics and Plus+ subscriptions
courses.description: Two yearly plans for the app, each opening with a seven-day trial. Basics covers Mindful Radio, podcasts, music and nature sounds, breathing exercises and short gratitude practices; Plus+ adds the full library of guided meditations and courses and a daily coached practice.

courses.title: Foundations of Mindfulness
courses.description: A self-paced thirty-day course with Melli O'Brien, fifteen minutes a day. The sessions move from the basics of attention and presence through mental noting, non-judgement and equanimity to bringing awareness into ordinary activity.

free_resources.title: How to Meditate: Meditation 101 for Beginners
free_resources.description: A free beginner's article that walks through a first sitting: posture, resting the hands, softening the gaze and following the breath for two minutes, then returning to it whenever the mind wanders. It also introduces ten styles of meditation, from loving-kindness to body scan.

flags: Health rule, borderline: the home page markets the app heavily on conditions (compares mindfulness with CBT and SSRI antidepressants; tabs for 'Ease anxiety', 'Sleep', 'Pain & illness'; member survey on stress and anxiety), and the Plus+ plan lists 'courses for anxiety, stress and more'. None of this is in the bio or items. Judged a teacher-led mindfulness app like Calm/Headspace rather than therapy-led; owner may prefer to skip it as with Aura and Breethe.
Brand inbox: support@mindfulness.com, shown as a mailto in the FAQ on the Foundations of Mindfulness page; also a contact form at /contact.
Possible override by published user numbers (1M+ members).

Teachers already on Spiritpedia who appear in the app: Cory Muscara (co-host), Tara Brach, Jack Kornfield, Sharon Salzberg, Joseph Goldstein, Jon Kabat-Zinn, Dr. Kristin Neff, Dr. Rick Hanson, Dr. Dan Siegel, Kelly Boys, Mark Coleman. Co-founder Melli O'Brien is not on Spiritpedia. Apps aren't hubs, so no links made.
